description: Refresh OAuth client redirect/branding metadata from the bound on-chain treasury (POST /mgr-api/clients/{id}/sync-from-treasury)

parameters.name: client-id
parameters.description: OAuth2 client ID to sync from its bound treasury

validation_rules: Requires xion:mgr:write scope (same as other mutating mgr routes)
No request body — reads redirect_url, icon_url, and display_url from on-chain treasury
Run after treasury update-params changes redirect_url or icon_url
Authorize redirect_uri in login flow must match treasury redirect_url

errors.remediation: Only the client owner can sync
Verify client ID, ownership, and mgr read/write scopes
